204.description: Queued again with fresh attempts (or an equivalent job already was)

404.description: No failed job with this id

200.description: Most recently changed first, at most 1000

201.description: Signed in: a new device and its tokens

204.description: This device is signed out; its tokens no longer work

200.description: New tokens. The refresh token was rotated; presenting the previous one again within 30 s returns the same new one, later it revokes the device
Live devices first, most recently seen first, then revoked ones

204.description: Revoked (or already revoked): its tokens no longer work; what it backed up stays

200.description: The file; active content types are served as application/octet-stream

parameters.name: v
parameters.description:
The `thumbnail.version` from the listing. Only a URL with the current
version is cached as immutable.

404.description: not_found, or not_ready while the worker has not produced it

get.summary: Healthy when the database answers and the data directory is reachable.

parameters.name: parent_id
parameters.description: Folder to list; omit it for the top-level folders.

204.description: Moved to the trash with everything inside it

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: Only this month (`YYYY-MM`, wall-clock capture time).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Words to find (1–200 characters): each must start a word of the
file's name or text, accents and case ignored.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Results to skip; `offset + limit` is at most 200.

200.description: Restored into its folder, or into Files/ if that folder is gone; renamed "name (n)" on a clash
Content already in your library: linked, nothing to upload

201.description: Session opened or resumed: send the missing chunks. A device also gets a new `upload_token` (the previous one stops working)

429.description: rate_limited, or too_many_uploads: too many open sessions, or they would reserve more than half the free space

204.description: Upload aborted and its bytes deleted

put.summary:
Stores one chunk at its offset. Chunks may arrive in any order and may be
re-sent; each must have exactly the planned length.

404.description: No such upload (or it was aborted, completed or expired)

503.description: busy: too many chunk uploads at once

201.description: File created; its name may carry a " (n)" suffix if the name was taken

409.description: upload_incomplete, already completing, or destination folder gone

503.description: busy: too many completions at once; retry

AccountDto.description: The signed-in user, as a device sees it.

oneOf.description: The chosen cover, else the newest photo; `null` for an empty album.

item_count.description: Photos in the album (trashed ones are not counted).

node_ids.description: 1–500 photo (file node) ids; ids that are not the caller's photos are skipped.

AlbumRef.description: An album a photo belongs to.

AssetDetails.description: Everything the photo viewer shows about one photo.

albums.description: Albums of the caller holding this photo, by name.

id.description: The file node's id (also used by `/api/files/{id}/…`).

width.description: Displayed size, once known. The grid treats unknown as square.

node_ids.description:
Photos to put in it right away (at most 500); ids that are not the
caller's photos are skipped.

email_hint.description: Optional reminder of who the invitation is for. Not used to send email.

device_asset_id.description:
The phone's id for this asset (devices only): recorded so the sync
check knows it is backed up.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the whole file, 64 lowercase hex characters.

taken_at.description:
When the photo or video was taken, by the client's clock: RFC 3339
with its UTC offset (`2024-07-14T18:30:05+02:00`). Used for the
timeline when the file itself (EXIF, name) has no date.

token.description: Shown once. Build the link as `<origin>/join/<token>`.

CurrentDeviceResponse.description: The calling device and its account.

DeduplicatedUpload.description:
The content was already in the caller's library: a node was created without
uploading anything.

current.description: Whether this is the calling device.

revoked_at.description: Set once the device was signed out; its tokens no longer work.

model.description: Hardware model, e.g. "Pixel 8". At most 64 characters.

name.description: Shown in Settings › Devices and used as the backup folder's name. 1–64 characters.

page_count.description: Pages of a PDF; `null` for other files or before it is processed.

snippet.description: Passages of the text around the matches; empty when only the name matched.

has_more.description:
Whether a page at `offset + limit` would return more (never past
200 results).

items.description: Name matches first, then by relevance.

failures.description: The 50 most recent failures, newest first (kept 30 days).

kinds.description: Queued, running and failed counts per job kind, kinds sorted.

can_invite.description: Whether this user may create invitations (instance setting and role).

csrf_token.description: Send back as `X-CSRF-Token` on every non-GET request.

MediaStatus.description: The caller's files still being processed (drives "Preparing 12 photos…").

queued.description: Waiting for their first processing step.

path.description: Ancestors from the top-level folder down, excluding the node itself.

is_root.description: Top-level folders cannot be renamed, moved or deleted.

mime.description: Detected from the content at upload; `null` for folders.

oneOf.description:
Set when a thumbnail is ready (`GET /api/files/{id}/thumbnail`); `null`
otherwise, and in listings that do not look thumbnails up.

items.description: Folders first, then files; names in byte order.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

PlaceDto.description: Where a photo was taken, named from the offline GeoNames dataset.

refresh_token.description: The current (or, after a lost response, the previous) `sqr_…` token.

SetupRequest.description:
Creates the first administrator. `setup_token` is the setup code printed in
the server log on first start (or `SQUIRREL_SETUP_TOKEN`).

setup_token.description: Missing is treated like a wrong code (403), not a validation error.

SnippetPart.description: A piece of a snippet; `highlight` marks a matched word.

trash_bytes.description: Bytes in the trash (purged after 30 days, not counted against the quota).

used_bytes.description: Logical bytes of live files: what the quota limits.

device_asset_id.description: The phone's stable id for the asset, 1–256 bytes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the asset's original bytes, 64 lowercase hex characters.

SyncCheckRequest.description: Which of these assets does the server miss?

items.description: 1–500 items, ids unique within the batch.

missing.description: The ids to upload, in request order. Everything else is already backed up.

SyncFolderRequest.description: Where to put this year's backups.

ThumbnailRef.description: A ready thumbnail of a file.

blurhash.description: A compact blurred placeholder (blurha.sh) to show while it loads.

version.description: Pass as `v` to the thumbnail URL: a new version is a new URL.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

TokenPair.description:
Tokens of one device. Send the access token as `Authorization: Bearer
<access_token>`; before it expires, trade the refresh token for a new pair
(`POST /api/auth/device/refresh`). Every refresh rotates the refresh token.

refresh_token.description: `sqr_…`. Store it securely; it is shown once.

node.description: `parent_id` is where it was deleted from.

items.description: Newest first. Folders appear once; their contents come back with them.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

UpdateAlbumRequest.description: Rename and/or choose the cover. At least one field is required.

cover_node_id.description:
A photo of the album to show as its cover; `null` goes back to the
newest photo; absent keeps the current choice.

UpdateNodeRequest.description: Rename and/or move. At least one field is required.

UploadSessionDto.description: An upload session: send the missing chunks, then complete it.

upload_token.description:
Devices only, when the session is opened or resumed: `squ_…`, sent as
`Authorization: Upload <token>` for this upload's chunks and status
(background transfers that outlive the access token). Shown once.

csrf_token.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrf_token.description: The session's `csrf_token` (from `GET /api/auth/me`), required with the session cookie on every non-GET request.

upload_token.name: Authorization
upload_token.description: Per-upload token `squ_…` from `POST /api/uploads`, sent as `Authorization: Upload squ_…`, for this upload's chunks and status only.
